title: Combine Similar Arms
goal: Match multiple variants with one pattern without repeating logic.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Pattern Matching

hints: Every branch of a pattern separated by `|` must bind the exact same variable names.
Struct field pattern shorthand `id` binds the field `id` directly to a variable named `id`.
explanation: OR patterns use a single pipe `|` to match multiple variants in one arm. Every branch of an OR pattern must bind the exact same variable names, so `Media::Book(id) | Media::Audio(code)` fails with `E0408` because `id` is not bound on both sides. Using `||` is invalid syntax because double pipe is a logical operator. For struct variants, writing `id` is shorthand for `id: id`, which binds the field to local variable `id`. Writing `id: code` binds `code` instead, leaving `id` undefined and causing `E0425`.
